name: Explorers' League
summary: The Explorers' League is a renowned dwarven archaeological guild headquartered in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Founded under King Magni Bronzebeard and led by his wandering brother Brann, the League seeks to uncover the forgotten origins of the dwarven race. Their expansive digs span across Azeroth, uncovering ancient titan ruins while frequently igniting regional conflicts.

sections.title: A Shift in Dwarven Purpose
sections.body: For centuries, the dwarves of Khaz Modan focused their formidable energies on mining, stonework, and engineering. That focus changed drastically when ancient ruins were unearthed, hinting at a forgotten legacy connecting dwarves to mythical titan creators. Eager to solve the mystery of his people's beginnings, King Magni Bronzebeard decreed that dwarven industry pivot heavily toward archaeology. Magni, alongside his brother Brann, established the Explorers' Guild—now widely known as the Explorers' League—to scour the world for relics, forgotten cities, and traces of their ancient ancestry.

sections.title: The Hall and the Digs
sections.body: The League's operations are directed from the cavernous Hall of Explorers in Ironforge, oversaw on a day-to-day administrative level by High Explorer Muninn Magellas while Brann Bronzebeard explores distant reaches. Across Khaz Modan and beyond, prospectors manage extensive digsites. Sites like Ironband's Excavation in Loch Modan and Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands uncover immense fossil records and ancient architecture. However, prospectors often find themselves under siege by displaced wildlife, troggs, and rival factions interested in subterranean relics.

sections.title: Frontier Clashes
sections.body: The League's aggressive expeditions have sparked fierce resistance outside dwarven homelands. In Kalimdor, League operations such as the Bael Modan dig in the southern Barrens drove out the native Stonespire tauren through heavy industrial blasting, stirring vengeance and angering local earth spirits. In the arid Badlands, League prospectors clash openly with the Dark Iron clan over the vast titan vaults of Uldaman. League agents also quietly share intelligence with Stormwind's covert SI:7 network, demonstrating that their worldwide excavations frequently intersect with high-stakes Alliance politics.

faq.answer: The Explorers' League is an Ironforge-based organization dedicated to surveying, archaeology, and researching the origins of the dwarven race. They maintain excavation sites across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor to unearth relics of the ancient world.

King Magni Bronzebeard helped found the guild, but his youngest brother, the renowned wanderer Brann Bronzebeard, serves as its official leader. In Brann's frequent absences across the globe, High Explorer Muninn Magellas oversees business from the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why did King Magni start the League?
faq.answer: After strange subterranean ruins revealed evidence that the dwarves were not merely born of ordinary mountain rock, King Magni shifted a massive portion of dwarven industry toward archaeology to discover the true, mythical heritage of his people.

Yes. While the League remains predominantly dwarven in membership, leadership, and aesthetic, individuals of other Alliance races do join, including adventurous gnomes like Clopper Wizbang, along with trusted field assistants across the continents.

faq.q: Why are the tauren fighting the Explorers' League?
faq.answer: In their race to excavate Kalimdor, dwarven prospectors at Bael Modan used heavy explosives and displaced the native Stonespire tauren tribe, decimating their settlement and outraging the local earth spirits through wanton destruction of sacred ground.

faq.q: What is Uldaman and why does the League care about it?
faq.answer: Uldaman is a massive underground titan facility buried beneath the Badlands. The League views it as the crown jewel of their research, believing its sealed chambers hold definitive proof regarding the transformation and ancient creation of the dwarven race.

angles.text: Every digsite and titan artifact brings the dwarven race closer to understanding their ancient creator roots and their departure from stone.
The League's careless use of dynamite in Kalimdor desecrated Stonespire ancestral lands, proving their relentless digging often comes at the expense of the earth.
Beyond academic curiosity, the League acts as an unofficial intelligence-gathering arm across remote territories, quietly passing encrypted findings to Stormwind's SI:7.
Dwarven prospectors rely heavily on mining traditions to shore up tunnels, survey strata, and extract delicate titan machinery from solid rock.
